_comment: Org rulesets, set by apply-rules.py and checked by verify-settings.py (design 6.4). A 'workflows' rule names its workflow by 'repository' (this org's repo) instead of GitHub's numeric id; rules.desired_org_rulesets() fills the id in, and applies each ruleset to the repos its 'repositories' lists (each must be in repos.txt), or to the archived repos its 'archived_repositories' lists (each archived and not in repos.txt; by repository id, as GitHub keeps them), or else to every repo in repos.txt. A required reviewer names its team by 'team' (a slug in teams.json) instead of its numeric id, which desired_org_rulesets() fills in. Other org rulesets are left alone and listed as a note.

rulesets.name: Release decision
rulesets._comment: The release-decision check (design 6.3, .github#248): a Release PR merges only on a partner's comment newer than its head. The repos that cut releases with release-please; each also calls release-decision-rerun.yml from main, so a comment re-runs the check.

rulesets.name: Merge and PR Gates
rulesets._comment: Kept exactly as it is live (design 6.2, .github#252): made by hand on 2026-08-09, before the move, for the old ani-motion-* repos, all archived since, so it has no effect while they stay archived.
